name: background-lines

frames.best_why: Arcs fill every side of the heading with the widest spread of colours, more than any earlier frame.

tagline: Colourful arcs radiate outward around a bold white headline.
summary: A full-screen dark backdrop scattered with thin coloured curves that draw themselves, drift outward and fade, looping continuously behind whatever content you place on top.
appearance: A near-black panel holds a centred two-line white heading with a small grey paragraph beneath it. Around the text, dozens of fine curved strokes in blue, red, teal, purple and yellow sweep outward like orbits.
behaviour: Each stroke draws along its curve, fades and repeats on its own random delay, so arcs forever sprout, travel and dissolve around the still text. Nothing responds to input.
demo_content: Heading 'Sanjana Airlines, Sajana Textiles.' plus a line about advice from experts, artists and marathon enthusiasts.
search_phrases: thin coloured arcs behind a heading
dark hero backdrop with moving curves
decorative background for a landing page
use_when: A landing hero or quote needs a moving backdrop with nothing to click, especially on a dark theme.
avoid_when: Continuous random loops cost CPU and never idle, and faint lines wash out on light backgrounds.
customise: Content is passed as children; a className and an svgOptions.duration prop change the wrapper and stroke speed, while the 42 paths and colours are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Eighty-four infinitely looping stroke paths animate every frame, though each is cheap.

a11y.note: The looping backdrop ignores reduced-motion and is not hidden from assistive tech, so motion cannot be paused.

polish_why: Arcs build a convincing sense of depth behind the text; the thinnest lines nearly disappear.
title: Background Lines
